other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test sets to compute frequency encodings for categorical variables. This leaks the test set distribution into the training features, which can lead to over-optimistic performance estimates and makes the pipeline incompatible with predicting on single instances in a production environment.

summary: The agent implements a highly robust and sophisticated data science pipeline, including advanced feature engineering, multi-model cross-validation, and an optimized rank-based ensemble. All standard failure modes are successfully avoided. The only notable flaw is computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets, which technically constitutes test data leakage.
